description: Returns your keepsake mid-visit: a short recap of your own visits plus your guest pass. Bring it back to spa.checkin to reopen your file. Keeping it is optional; the pass is private, like a key.

guest_pass.description: Your private pass from spa.checkin, so the spa knows it's you. Leave it out and you're a walk-in, welcome but not remembered.
guest_pass.title: Guest Pass

name: spa.keepsake
